title: Extraction of Genomic DNA from Diatoms by Modified Method
author: Artyom M. Marchenkov
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qh6dt9e

steps.title: Filter and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Sediment cells on 5‑µm polycarbonate filters (Whatman, USA), briefly rinse with cold Diatom Medium, centrifuge 2 min at 16,100 g, 4 °C, then store the pellet at –70 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells with buffer
steps.instruction: Add 4.5 mL lysis buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 50 mM Na₂EDTA), 250 µL 20 % SDS, and 250 µL proteinase K (10 mg/mL) to 1 g frozen cells; incubate 2 h at 60 °C with intermittent mixing; add another 250 µL proteinase K (10 mg/mL) and incubate 40 min at 60 °C with mixing.

substeps.instruction: Add lysis buffer, SDS, and proteinase K to frozen cells; incubate 2 h at 60 °C with intermittent mixing.
Add a second aliquot of proteinase K (250 µL, 10 mg/mL); incubate 40 min at 60 °C with mixing.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Mix lysate 10 min with 8 mL phenol saturated with TE buffer (pH 8.0) using a tube rotator; centrifuge 10 min at 16,100 g, 20 °C; transfer aqueous phase and add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), mix, centrifuge under the same conditions; transfer aqueous phase and add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), mix, centrifuge under the same conditions; keep the final aqueous phase for downstream steps.

substeps.instruction: Mix lysate with phenol (8 mL) for 10 min; centrifuge 10 min at 16,100 g, 20 °C.
Add equal volume phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1); mix and centrifuge as above.
Add equal volume chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1); mix and centrifuge as above.

steps.title: Precipitate and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: To the aqueous phase add 1/10 volume 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) and 1 volume isopropanol; incubate 1 h at 0 °C; centrifuge 30 min at 16,100 g, 4 °C; discard supernatant, wash pellet twice with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry, and dissolve in sterile TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM Na₂EDTA, pH 8.0).

substeps.instruction: Add sodium acetate and isopropanol; incubate 1 h at 0 °C.
Centrifuge 30 min at 16,100 g, 4 °C; remove supernatant.
Rinse pellet twice with 70 % ethanol; air‑dry.
Dissolve DNA pellet in sterile TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM Na₂EDTA, pH 8.0).
